user.title: Connect to Norman Hub
user.description: Connect to your Norman Hub to control your blinds. The hub is reached directly on your local network; nothing goes through the cloud.

data_description.host: The address of the Norman Hub on your network. Give it a fixed address in your router so it does not change.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Norman Hub found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Add the Norman Hub at {host}? It was found on your local network and answered as a Norman hub.

reconfigure.title: Update Norman Hub address
reconfigure.description: Enter the hub's new address. It must be the same hub this entry was set up with.

data_description.host: The address of the Norman Hub on your network.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Norman Hub
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address or hostname (no port or path)
error.invalid_response: Invalid response received from the Norman Hub

abort.already_configured: This Norman Hub is already configured
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Norman Hub
abort.invalid_response: Invalid response received from the Norman Hub
abort.reconfigure_successful: The hub address has been updated
abort.wrong_hub: That address belongs to a different Norman Hub

nudge_position.name: Nudge position
nudge_position.description: Move a cover by a relative amount from where it is heading (or is).

step.name: Step
step.description: Amount to move by, -100 to 100. Positive opens, negative closes.

nudge_tilt.name: Nudge tilt
nudge_tilt.description: Adjust a cover's tilt by a relative amount from where it is heading (or is).

step.name: Step
step.description: Amount to tilt by, -100 to 100. Direction depends on the blind; for SmartDrape, negative tilts left.

room_command.name: Room command
room_command.description: Run one of the Norman app's room buttons against every blind in a room, in a single request to the hub.

room.name: Room
room.description: The room's name as the hub knows it (the Norman app's room name).

command.name: Command
command.description: best_privacy closes the bottom rail and leaves the middle rail where it is; best_view opens the bottom rail; favorite sends the room to its stored favorite.

config_entry_id.name: Hub
config_entry_id.description: Which hub, when more than one is set up.

get_hub_data.name: Get hub data
get_hub_data.description: Read the hub's raw device list and status, exactly as the hub sends them. Returns a response; use it from Developer Tools or a script when reporting an unsupported blind.

config_entry_id.name: Hub
config_entry_id.description: Which Norman hub to read. Optional when only one is configured.

send_hub_command.name: Send hub command
send_hub_command.description: Advanced. POST arbitrary fields to the hub's control endpoint for one blind and return the reply. For the hub verbs that have no entity of their own, such as setting or clearing a limit and calibration. The blind will do whatever the hub makes of the fields.

config_entry_id.name: Hub
config_entry_id.description: Which Norman hub to send to. Optional when only one is configured.

peripheral_uid.name: Peripheral UID
peripheral_uid.description: The blind's id as the hub reports it (the cover's unique id, or PeripheralUID in get_hub_data).

fields.name: Fields
fields.description: Extra JSON fields for the control call. PeripheralUID, Timestamp and TaskID are filled in automatically.

hub_read_failed.message: Could not read from Norman hub {hub}: {error}

hub_command_rejected.message: Norman hub {hub} rejected the command for {uid}: {error}

unknown_entry.message: No Norman hub with config entry id {entry_id}

unknown_room.message: No room called "{room}" on this hub. Known rooms: {rooms}.

command_needs_a_room.message: {command} needs a room; only {commands} can be sent to the whole hub.
